name: Black Spy
summary: A Hearts-like trick-taking game where players avoid black cards, except for a shoot-the-moon bonus for taking all 16.
rules_text: Deck has 60 cards: 11 ranks x 5 colors (blue, yellow, red, green, black) plus 5 extra black Rank-7 Spies. Rank 1 to 11 low to high. Deal all cards: 20/15/12/10 cards for 3/4/5/6 players. Each deal players pass 3 face-down cards: alternate left/right (with across added for 4 players). Cannot look at incoming until you passed. Red 1 leads first trick, black may not be led first trick. In trick order clockwise, must follow lead color or lead rank if able, else any card. Highest rank in lead color wins trick; if multiple black Spies are highest, earliest wins. Winner collects trick face-down and leads next. After all tricks score: black Rank 1-6 =1 each, black Spy=10 each, Rank 8=2, 9=3, 10=4, 11=5, non-black Spy=-5. Totals 60 per deal. If a player took all 16 black cards they score 0 and all others score 60. Game ends when any cumulative score reaches 200/150/120/100 for 3/4/5/6 players; lowest total wins.
